question: Does a realizable between-answer scale change improve PRMScore while the within-answer ranking stays exactly the same?
comparators_no_retuning: original prmscore_inner of each method from the run
calibration_scores_for_outer_fold_k: inner-held predictions of the 4 jobs prm__fold{k}__evidence__all__spectral__inner{j}, j != k; each fitted excluding folds k and j; transform applied per whole answer; concatenated over the 4 folds j
evaluation_scores_for_outer_fold_k: outer-held OOF scores of fold k (OOF_STEP_SCORES.npz), transformed per whole answer
threshold_grid: quantiles 0.50..0.99 step 0.01 of the pooled calibration step scores (50 values)

threshold_selection.inner_selected: quantile maximizing total PRMScore on calibration labels, eligibility = classification != 'correct'; ties -> lower quantile; the NUMERIC threshold is frozen and applied to fold k (supervised calibration)
threshold_selection.q80: fixed quantile 0.80 of the calibration scores (label-free)

decision: step VALID iff transformed score < threshold (lower score = less suspicious)
identity_check: within-answer AUROC of C_Z and C_ECDF must equal C_RAW to 1e-12 for every method
evaluator: spectral_utils/prmbench.py::prmbench_evaluate (frozen official port); vectorized total-PRMScore reimplementation verified against all 114 saved decision sets before use

primary_family.uncertainty: paired source-group bootstrap, 100000 draws, seed 20260923, 95% CI and Bonferroni 97.5% CI

secondary: original PRMScore of the run beside recalibrated C_RAW
interpretation_rule: PRMScore up with identical within-AUC = a better use of the same rankings for the decision contract, not new localization information. No improvement in both transforms does not close all calibration methods; do not search further transforms.
budget: <= 2 CPU-hours before evaluation; no fit of histogram/teacher/SSL
